description: Refuse a roster day longer than 12 hours for a Part 4 employee within the salary ceiling.
validate:
const intervals = get(ctx.entry, 'actual_worked_intervals', []);
return interval_minutes(intervals) <= ctx.lookup.roster_warnings.daily_hours * 60;

references.title: Employment Act 1968 s.38(8), read 2026-10-07
references.quote: Employment Act 1968 s.38(8) (https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/EmA1968?ProvIds=pr38-), read 2026-10-07: never more than 12 hours in a day save an accident, work essential to the community, defence or security, urgent work to machinery or plant, or an unforeseeable interruption. A warning: the emergency is a fact the sheet does not carry.

description: Refuse more than 6 consecutive hours without a 45-minute meal break.

references.title: Employment Act 1968 s.38(1)(a), (c), read 2026-10-07. A warning
references.quote: Employment Act 1968 s.38(1)(a), (c) (https://sso.agc.gov.sg/Act/EmA1968?ProvIds=pr38-), read 2026-10-07. A warning: work that must be carried on continuously may run 8 consecutive hours including at least 45 minutes for a meal.

description: Refuse night work between 23:00 and 06:00 for a manual worker under 16.

references.title: MOM, Employing young persons and children, read 2026-10-07, on the Employment (Children and Young Pe
references.quote: MOM, Employing young persons and children (https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/young-persons-and-children), read 2026-10-07, on the Employment (Children and Young Persons) Regulations made under Employment Act 1968 ss.70, 73 (child: under 15; young person: 15, s.67A). The prohibition admits no exception, so the schedule must be fixed: refused.

description: Refuse more than 6 hours a day for a child under 15, or 7 hours for a young person under 16.

references.title: MOM, Employing young persons and children, read 2026-10-07, on the Employment (Children and Young Pe
references.quote: MOM, Employing young persons and children (https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/young-persons-and-children), read 2026-10-07, on the Employment (Children and Young Persons) Regulations made under Employment Act 1968 ss.70, 73 (child: under 15; young person: 15, s.67A). Refused: no exception. School hours are not on the sheet, so only the recorded work is counted.

description: Refuse work on a rest day by a manual worker under 16 unless the Commissioner permits it.

references.title: MOM, Employing young persons and children, read 2026-10-07, on the Employment (Children and Young Pe
references.quote: MOM, Employing young persons and children (https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/young-persons-and-children), read 2026-10-07, on the Employment (Children and Young Persons) Regulations made under Employment Act 1968 ss.70, 73 (child: under 15; young person: 15, s.67A). A warning: the permission is a fact the sheet does not carry.

description: Refuse a continuous stretch over 3 hours for a child under 15, or 4 hours for a young person under 16, without a 30-minute break.

references.title: MOM, Employing young persons and children, read 2026-10-07, on the Employment (Children and Young Pe
references.quote: MOM, Employing young persons and children (https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/young-persons-and-children), read 2026-10-07, on the Employment (Children and Young Persons) Regulations made under Employment Act 1968 ss.70, 73 (child: under 15; young person: 15, s.67A). The maximum accumulated worked hours resets only after a break of at least 30 minutes. Shorter gaps do not reset it; overlapping or duplicated recorded intervals are counted once. School hours remain separately relevant to the daily cap.

description: Refuse a residency, work pass or work classification outside the Singapore categories the version declares.
Require the permanent-residence start date so the CPF graduated rates can be chosen.
Refuse contract hours and days outside their sane bounds.
Require an employment and a reference on a retrenchment or overseas-departure notice.
Require the expected departure date; a recorded expected return may not precede it.
Refuse sick and hospitalisation leave together above the year's hospitalisation entitlement.

references.title: Employment Act 1968 s.89(1): hospitalisation leave of up to 60 days a year includes outpatient sick leave of up to 14 days.
